summary: PASS: All nine MoviesListViewModel unit tests are well-structured and cover the required scenarios. Concurrency test uses TCS gating with RunContinuationsAsynchronously (best practice). Exception path test confirms IsLoading is reset in the finally block. JSON round-trip test validates all 12 column-visibility entries. FakeSettingsService is a clean in-memory ISettingsService. FakeMovieCatalogRepository TCS extension is minimal and correctly tracked by GetMovieListCallCount. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: MoviesListViewModelTests.cs: MakeItem() explicitly sets Modified = null, making the nullable intent self-documenting. Clean pattern — no issues.

LoadAsync_ConcurrentCall_SecondCallIsNoOp correctly uses TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously on the TCS, which prevents synchronous continuation execution on the SetResult caller's thread. This is best practice for concurrency test infrastructure.

FakeSettingsService correctly raises SettingsChanged after persisting, mirrors the real service contract. Placed in TestHelpers namespace, separate from the Infrastructure.Tests fake — avoids a cross-project test dependency.
No observations — code is clean and consistent with established project conventions.
